description_en: Sends messages in batches to multiple devices under a specified product by using a custom topic
description_zh: 通过自定义Topic，向指定产品下的多个设备，批量发送消息
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-pub --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --message-content eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBiYXRjaHB1YiBicm9hZGNhc3QifQ== --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchPub

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which you want to send messages
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The quality of service (QoS) level of the message. Valid values:

0: The message is sent at most once.
1: The message is sent at least once.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 0 is used.

Messages with QoS=1 can be retained on IoT Platform for up to 7 days. IoT Platform does not retain messages with QoS=0
parameters.help_zh:
指定消息的发送方式。取值：

0：最多发送一次。
1：最少发送一次。

如果不传入此参数，则使用默认值0。

QoS=1的消息在物联网平台中最多可以保存7天。物联网平台不保存QoS=0的消息
parameters.name: qos

parameters.help_en:
The suffix of the custom topic.
The custom topic is in the format of `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`. Specify the suffix ${TopicShortName}.

The specified topic must have the Subscribe permission or the Publish and Subscribe permission, and all devices must have subscribed to the topic.

You can view custom topics by using the following methods:
On the product details page, click the Topic Categories tab to view the custom topics of the product.
On the device details page, click the Topic List tab to view the custom topics to which the device has subscribed.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69647.html operation to query the custom topics of the product
parameters.help_zh:
自定义Topic的后缀。
自定义Topic的格式为`/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`，传入后缀${TopicShortName}。

指定Topic的操作权限须为订阅，或发布和订阅，且所有设备已订阅该Topic。

您可通过以下途径查看自定义Topic：
在产品详情页的Topic类列表页签下，查看产品下的自定义Topic。
在设备详情页的Topic列表页签下，查看设备已订阅的自定义Topic。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69647.html接口查询产品下的自定义Topic
parameters.name: topic_short_name

parameters.help_en:
The message body. The maximum size is 256 KB.

You must convert the original message into binary data and then perform Base64 encoding to generate the message body
parameters.help_zh:
要发送的消息主体。最大报文256 KB。

您需要将消息原文转换成二进制数据，并进行Base64编码，从而生成消息主体
parameters.name: message_content

parameters.help_en:
The names of the devices to which you want to send messages.

This parameter is used together with ProductKey. The specified devices must belong to the same product.
You can specify up to 100 device names in a single call. Device names cannot be duplicate
parameters.help_zh:
要接收消息的设备名称。

与ProductKey结合使用，传入设备必须属于同一产品。
单次调用，最多传入100个设备名称，且设备名称不可重复
parameters.name: device_name
